dedupe_keys.name: leakg3pd t od customer tank demand only leakage benchmark

description: LeakG3PD-T-OD provides a demand-focused leakage benchmark derived from the 500 Net3 scenarios with private customer tanks in LeakG3PD-T. Matheus Pilotto and collaborators copy simulated demands as if metered, then add missing values, fraud and measurement error. They replace network tanks with reservoirs and pumps with low-roughness pipes without the original pump switching controls. Imposed head patterns and rerun hydraulics generate estimated pressures and link flows; leak locations are encoded by distance along their original pipes. Coverage is a synthetic water-distribution case, not an observed city network. The inspected README does not establish calendar bounds or sampling frequency. Public access to EPANET Net 3_T_OD.zip is free and requires no sign-in. The GitHub generator uses EUPL 1.2, while separate archive terms are not stated. The authors warn that regenerated values differ and further development is needed for practical deployment. Simulation uses include checking demand-based leak detection and inferred pressure calibration when customers have tanks. It relates to model-wntr and data-leakdb. The public archive was identified but its payload was not inspected.
